D: A Bedrock quarry worker gets a big promotion, not knowing his new boss wants him as the fall guy for a swindle.
P: Serve the steak sliders when Dino grabs a steak off the grill.
S: Dino gets to Barney's steak first.

Cook the onions slowly in the butter with a pinch of salt until soft and golden. Rub the steak with oil and salt and sear in a very hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes a side, then rest it. Slice the steak thinly across the grain. Split the rolls and fill with rocket, steak, onions and a spoon of relish.
Parmesan cheese straws in puff pastry. Swapped test papers.

Brush the pastry with egg and scatter with the parmesan and paprika. Cut into 2cm strips and twist each one like a chisel handle. Bake on a lined tray at 200C until puffed and golden. Warm the passata with the garlic and oil for a dip.
M: Bronto ribs at the Bedrock Drive-In
Big beef ribs braised until tender, for family night at the Bedrock Drive-In.

Season the ribs and brown them all over in a heavy pot. Add the onion and stock, cover and bake at 160C until the meat almost falls off the bone. Simmer the barbecue sauce with the sugar and half the vinegar until sticky. Brush the ribs with the glaze and grill until charred at the edges. Toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayo and the rest of the vinegar and serve with the ribs.
T-bone steaks off the grill. Fred says red meat never hurt his dad.

Prick the potatoes, rub with oil and salt and bake at 200C until the skins are crisp. Mash the butter with the garlic and parsley. Grill the T-bones over high heat, 4 to 5 minutes a side, then rest them. Split the potatoes and top with sour cream and chives. Serve each steak with a slice of garlic butter melting on top.
W: Thick chocolate slab with biscuit. Mr Slate names Concretia after his daughter.

Melt the chocolate and butter together, then stir in the sugar. Beat in the eggs, then fold in the flour, cocoa and milk. Pour into a lined 20cm square tin and bake at 160C until just set. Cool, cut into slabs and top with cream and crushed cookie rubble.
K: Barney raises his lava juice to Fred.
Stir the blood orange juice, mango nectar and lime juice together in a jug. Fill 4 glasses with ice, pour in the juice and top with ginger beer.
